description:
About the Fellowship

The Umeå University Post-doctoral Scholarship in Bacterial Genetics is a 2-year, full-time, tax-free postdoc scholarship hosted by the Cava Lab at the Department of Molecular Biology and MIMS (Laboratory of Molecular Infection Medicine Sweden). The application deadline is 7 October 2026 and the start date is 1 November 2026 or by agreement.

About the Research Project

The Cava Lab is a multidisciplinary research environment focused on bacterial cell-wall biology and genetics. The postdoc project investigates genetic mechanisms controlling bacterial peptidoglycan formation, remodeling, recycling, and cell-wall homeostasis. The work aims to identify additional genes involved in cell-wall assembly and understand how they function as biological networks. Because cell-wall processes are proven targets for antibiotics, the research carries both fundamental and translational relevance for infectious-disease research.

Financial Coverage & Living Allowances

  • Tax-free scholarship stipend for the full two years (Swedish postdoc scholarships are tax-exempt as they are granted for educational purposes, not employment).
  • Full-time, 2-year postdoctoral research placement at Umeå University.
  • Research experience within the Cava Lab and access to MIMS research environment and infrastructure.
  • Opportunity to strengthen publication record and collaborate across infectious-disease and molecular-biology groups.
  • Potential involvement in supervising Master's students.
  • Progress is reviewed at a midterm assessment.
  • For context: comparable internal Umeå postdoc scholarships pay around 360,000 SEK per year (720,000 SEK over two years) tax-free; exact amount is confirmed on the official advertisement page.

Eligibility and Requirements

  • Formal qualifications: Applicants must hold a PhD or equivalent foreign doctoral degree in Medical Sciences, Life Sciences, or a closely related discipline. The doctoral qualification must be completed no later than the time the scholarship recipient is formally selected. Candidates who have not yet formally received their PhD may apply if they provide documentation showing expected completion date.
  • PhD recency rule: Preference is given to applicants whose doctorate was completed within three years of the application deadline. Earlier graduates may still be considered where justified by career interruptions such as parental leave, illness, military service, or similar circumstances.
  • Desired research experience: Molecular biology and bacterial genetics; microscopy experience, particularly with Alphaproteobacteria; knowledge of cell-wall biology and peptidoglycan recycling; ability to conduct research independently and work in multidisciplinary teams; good written and spoken English. Experience with protein purification or biochemical analysis of bacterial cell walls is an additional advantage.
  • Eligible nationalities: Open to international applicants of all nationalities.

Application dates

MilestoneDate
Application deadline7 October 2026
Start date1 November 2026 or by agreement
Midterm assessmentApproximately 1 year after start

Application Process

  1. Prepare a targeted cover letter connecting your background to the Cava Lab's work on bacterial genetics, peptidoglycan, and cell-wall biology.
  2. Prepare an academic CV with complete publication list, education, technical skills, and research achievements.
  3. Include PhD documentation (degree certificate or expected-completion documentation).
  4. Provide contact details for two referees.
  5. Submit via Umeå University's Varbi e-recruitment system before 7 October 2026 (documents in English or Swedish, Word or PDF).
  6. Direct questions to Felipe Cava (felipe.cava@umu.se).

Official Link

  • Official advertisement and application: https://www.umu.se/en/work-with-us/postdoctoral-scholarships/post-doctoral-scholarship-in-bacterial-genetics-at-umea-university_951891
  • All postdoctoral scholarships at Umeå University: https://www.umu.se/en/work-with-us/postdoctoral-scholarships
  • Cava Lab website: https://thecavalab.com
  • Application portal (Varbi): https://umustipendie.varbi.com

Note: This is a scholarship, not an employment contract. There is no salary, employment benefits, or paid annual leave; the stipend is tax-free because it funds independent research training.

Important Notes

  • Always confirm the full requirements and current deadline on the official website before applying.
  • Prepare the requested documents early — competitive awards are often decided on complete, on-time submissions.
  • Funding terms shown here reflect the listing at the time of publication and can be updated by the provider.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 7 October 2026. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
